framework_metadata.description: Complete interpretation guide for house rulers placed in houses
framework_metadata.usage: Essential technique for chart synthesis—shows how life areas connect

methodology.what_is_house_ruler: The planet that rules the sign on the house cusp
methodology.example: If Gemini is on 7th house cusp, Mercury is the 7th house ruler
methodology.dual_rulership: Signs with two rulers (Scorpio, Aquarius, Pisces) can use both traditional and modern
methodology.interpretation_principle: House ruler's placement shows WHERE and HOW that house's themes manifest
methodology.synthesis: Ruler's condition (sign, dignity, aspects) modifies expression

synthesis_principles.multiple_factors: Consider ruler's sign, dignity, aspects, and house for complete picture
synthesis_principles.house_connections: Shows which life areas naturally connect and inform each other
synthesis_principles.life_narrative: House rulers create a story of how life areas interweave
synthesis_principles.timing: When ruler is activated by transit/progression, both houses activate
synthesis_principles.emphasis: Multiple rulers in one house shows major life emphasis there
synthesis_principles.empty_houses: House ruler shows how empty house expresses

chart_reading_sequence: 2. Note which houses have multiple rulers placed in them (emphasis)
3. Check for mutual reception (two rulers in each other's signs)
6. Synthesize story of how life areas connect
practical_application.timing_activations: Transit to house ruler activates both the ruled house and the house it's in
practical_application.rectification: House ruler placements can help rectify birth time
